findings.location: <div class="poem"> paragraph 1, line about the moon
findings.source_quote: The crescent moon is closer yet to you,
findings.suggested_fix: Replace "Den voksende månen" with a phrase that matches "crescent moon". Suggested wording: "Halvmånen er enda nærmere deg," or "Sigdmånen er enda nærmere deg," depending on preferred Norwegian astronomical/poetic term.
findings.translation_quote: Den voksende månen er enda nærmere deg,

findings.location: <div class="poem"> paragraph 1, line about sky silence
findings.source_quote: In the still silence of the spacious sky,
findings.suggested_fix: Avoid the redundant repetition of "stille". Suggested wording: "I den stille, vide himmelen," or "I den stille vidstrakte himmelen," to preserve meaning and read naturally in Bokmål.
findings.translation_quote: I den stille stillheten i den vide himmel,

findings.location: <div class="poem"> paragraph 1, line about reaching the tiny sphere
findings.source_quote:
And yet it took man three whole days to reach
    That tiny sphere so very close at hand.
findings.suggested_fix:
Make the Norwegian phrasing more natural. Suggested wording: "Og likevel tok det mennesket tre hele dager å nå
    Den lille sfæren som var så nær," or "...å nå den lille sfæren som lå så nær."
findings.translation_quote:
Og likevel tok det mennesket hele tre dager å nå
    Den lille sfæren så nær for hånden.
